messages.content: An office supply company makes two types of printers: color printers and black and white printers. Different sections of the factory with different teams produce each printer. The color printer team can produce at most 30 color printers per day while the black and white printer team can produce at most 20 black and white printers per day. Both teams require use of the same paper tray installing machine and this machine can make at most 23 printers of either type each day. messages.content: A mining company has available a total of 60 square miles of mining sites and considering the use of two mining techniques: heap leaching and vat leaching. For each square mile of land, heap leaching technique can have a daily production of 2 tons of rare earth oxide per square miles but it also creates 10 tons of polluted wastewater and requires 20 extraction machines. On the other hand, vat leaching technique produces 3 tons of rare earth oxide per square miles per day while creating 12 tons of polluted wastewater and requiring 30 extraction machines. There are 60 machines available and due to environmental regulations, the amount of polluted wastewater must be at most 100 tons daily. Find the proportion of lands that use each mining technique in order to maximize the daily production of rare earth oxide.

messages.content: A pharmaceutical company makes skin cream in batches, a regular batch and premium batch, to sell to hospitals. The regular batch requires 40 units of medicinal ingredients and 30 units of rehydration product. A premium batch requires 30 units of medicinal ingredients and 100 units of rehydration product. Since the premium batch sells better, the number of regular batches must be less than the number of premium batches. In addition, the company must make at least 8 regular batches. If a regular batch can treat 40 people and a premium batch can treat 20 people, how many of each batch should be made to maximize the number of people that can be treated?

Since pills are more popular, the number of batches of vitamin pills must be larger than the number of batches of vitamin shots. Further, the clinic can make at most 7 batches of vitamin shots. The clinic has available 1700 units of vitamin C and 1100 units of vitamin D. If each batch of vitamin shots can supply 7 people and each batch of vitamin pills can supply 6 people, how many batches of each should be made to maximize the number of people that can be supplied?

messages.content: An incandescent bulb manufacturing company uses either an argon gas approach or halogen gas approach to fill their light bulbs. The argon gas approach uses 6 units of gas and 9 units of glass to make 3 light bulbs. The halogen gas approach uses 9 units of gas and 7 units of glass to make 4 light bulbs. Additionally, the argon gas approach generates 4 units of heat while the halogen gas approach creates 2 units of heat. The manufacturing company has available 120 units of gas and 94 units of glass. If at most 16 units of heat can be generated during the manufacturing process, how many of each method should be used to maximize the number of light bulbs produced?
